structure: Part 2 read the whole verbatim quote and preamble (lines 1-136) and sections (e) to (h), lines 375-495: (e) Commodities wait on MDM, claims 28-33; (f) Transporter management waits on requirements, claims 34-37; (g) Documents, claim 38; (h) Who owns the overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation, claims 39-42. Sam's own words for points 2 (commodities), 4 (documents), 5 (transporters) and 7 (overview ownership) are claimed from the quote; the listed claims are each checked against the quote and marked verbatim where they are Sam's ruling and inferred where the file says they are the orchestrator's application of his principle. Point 7a's ownership confirmation is claimed here; its plants-consistency half (and point 7b) is section (i), part 3's. Gaps record what the quote leaves open: MDM timing and shape, who decides transporter management, the 50 MB ticket's identity in Sam's words, and the embryos/ova default.
